tasks.user_query: On Windows, reinstalling the Cursor agent hooks can leave duplicate Entire hook entries. The hook command is wrapped differently depending on whether a working POSIX `sh` is detected at install time (an `sh -c '...'` wrapper) or not (a native `cmd.exe /d /s /c "..."` wrapper). When that detection result changes between two installs on the same host, a normal reinstall (without `--force`) does not replace the previously written wrapper: it keeps the old `sh -c` entry AND adds the new `cmd.exe` entry for the same hook type. The `.cursor` hooks file then holds two Entire hooks of the same type, so the hook can fire twice - producing duplicate session-start/stop events and duplicate checkpoints. Make a non-force reinstall end with exactly one Entire hook entry per type after the wrapper form changes, without disturbing any non-Entire hooks the user has configured.
oracle_queries: reinstall must replace stale Entire-managed hook forms
sh -c wrapper versus cmd.exe wrapper hook installation Windows probe
